fieldValues.title: An essay cannot show the domain, problems, claims and remedies it speaks about
fieldValues.statement: An essay builds on the same chain of meaning the research base holds: it speaks about a domain, the problems personas face in their experience of that domain, the claims it makes and the remedies it suggests. It may not start in a domain, but it comes to fit one. As I write I want to link to each of these elements, and see which the essay covers; today a paragraph can only point at a problem, and the essay as a whole says nothing about its domain, personas or remedies.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: essays fit into a domain and link to its problems, claims and remedies as they are written
